newsitem.title: USA: A. Schulman sees growth resuming in FY97.
newsitem.headline: A. Schulman sees growth resuming in FY97.

text.p: A. Schulman Inc said on Monday that it expects to resume growth in fiscal 1997 with an economic recovery in Europe and stabilized resin prices.

Earlier in the day the company reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.37 per share and fiscal 1996 earnings of $1.12 per share. Year-ago earnings figures were $0.32 for the fourth quarter and $1.43 for the year.
The plastic compounds and resin supplier blamed lower earnings in fiscal 1996 on a sharp drop in plastic resin prices that caused customers to cut inventories and led to lower profit margins.

It said declining profits bottomed in the second quarter and improved through the fourth quarter. With stabilized prices, European economic recovery and manufacturing facilities being built to increase capacity by 4 percent, "we should resume a pattern of growth in fiscal 1997," the company stated.
